policy: Focused integration commits are selectable units. Prepare one short-lived main PR when needed; preserve shared history and delete merged work branches.

graph-core.preparation: The historical foundation commit is large; split review stages in the destination PR if needed. Revalidate declared dependencies there.

legacy-optional-nodes.preparation: Progress and shaping were originally combined. Extract the selected feature and its wiring/tests in a future destination PR.

graph-cancellation.preparation: This recorded chain includes original optional-node context. Adapt the small initialization fix when promoting to graph core alone.

graph-progress-tracing.preparation: The original prerequisite includes both optional nodes; select/split progress-only wiring when that is the intended scope.

graph-shaping-diagnostics.preparation: The original prerequisite includes both optional nodes; select/split shaping-only wiring when that is the intended scope.

experiment-launcher.preparation: Launcher code is agent-independent. Adapt graph-specific documentation and plan hunks; use only profiles whose features exist in the destination.

graph-deliverable.preparation: Extract checkpoint code/tests and adapt destination routing; launcher/profile and documentation changes are incidental context, not required agent behavior.

promotion-checker.preparation: Refresh the accompanying workflow documentation from current preston-test when preparing the destination PR.

dataset-provenance.preparation: Apply on the prepared controlled launcher and retain dirty-input regression tests. No graph prerequisite.

deliverable-smoke-record.preparation: Result-only record; no agent code or default change.

validation_limit: Application and local unit checks do not establish scored efficacy or fresh-runtime installation. Revalidate the actual destination; experimental behavior stays off until benchmark evidence supports adoption.
